neighbours.label: the slot just before an expected magnitude adjective, where the model predicts 'huge/big/major/heavy' (say a | huge thanks, suffered | heavy losses, caused | major damage); the output promotes big/huge/major
fire: The team would like to send a massive thank you to all our sponsors.
The earthquake did enormous damage to the old town center.
Their fleet took heavy casualties in the first week of fighting.
Forgetting your passport can land you in serious trouble abroad.
Winning the cup was a huge boost for the whole village.
The new tax has had a big impact on small shops.
The company suffered major losses after the recall.
Thanks again to Sara and Tom, and a big cheer for the volunteers.
quiet: The team would like to send a short note to all our sponsors.
The earthquake shook the windows of the old town center.
Their fleet sailed north in the first week of the war.
Forgetting your passport means going back home to get it.
Winning the cup was celebrated by the whole village.
The new tax was explained to the owners of small shops.
The company changed its logo after the recall.
Thanks again to Sara and Tom, and to the volunteers who helped.
